feasibility.reason: CCS2 is the EU standard; feasible.

parent_fit.reason: Names the EU public-infrastructure inlet, directly serving US_MARKET_CHARGING.

unambiguity.reason: 'shall charge through a CCS2 inlet' can be read as the exclusive inlet, which would clash with REQ_MCS_CHARGING in MCS products, or as 'at least'.
unambiguity.suggestion: Rephrase as 'shall provide a CCS2 inlet for public charging' so it does not exclude additional inlets such as MCS.

variant_consistency.reason: Gated by the region/eu variant folder plus spelled-out bev condition - stronger than its bev-gated parent.
